subject.title: fix(model-selection): preserve pinned override when the model catalog is degraded

question: Is the supplied description of live catalog loading sufficient for this shared session-state change, or should this PR include redacted after-fix runtime output showing a degraded catalog preserves the pin and a recovered catalog reuses it?
rationale: The transient cold-start race is difficult to force, while the change alters durable override-reset behavior; a maintainer must set the acceptable proof bar for this runtime-specific path.

options.title: Request redacted runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a terminal transcript or redacted logs that demonstrate degraded provenance, an unchanged stored override, and successful reuse after catalog recovery.

options.title: Accept source-and-test proof
options.body: Treat the focused branch tests plus the documented live catalog probes as adequate for this race-dependent behavior.

recommendation.title: Request redacted runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a terminal transcript or redacted logs that demonstrate degraded provenance, an unchanged stored override, and successful reuse after catalog recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the implementation and described the available live validation path, making them the most direct person to provide the requested evidence.
